pieces.Text: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day, you can use baleful polymorph, except you change the target into a horribly mutated form of the chosen animal. The target takes a -4 penalty on its saving throw to resist your spell (if the new form would prove fatal for the creature, it still gains a +4 bonus on its saving throw, effectively negating this penalty). In addition to the other effects of the spell, the subject is in constant pain from its twisted and disfigured form, and takes 1d6 points of nonlethal damage each round. This constant agony imposes a -2 penalty on all of the target's ability checks, skill checks, saving throws, attack rolls, and damage rolls.
